subject: Refund request - accidentally purchased annual plan
description: Hi, I accidentally clicked 'Annual' when I meant to choose monthly. I noticed the charge immediately and I'm requesting a refund within the first hour of purchase. I have not generated anything yet.
resolution: Full refund approved immediately. Customer contacted within 30 minutes. Refund processed same day. No usage detected, charge was 47 minutes prior to ticket submission.

subject: Credits expired but I was on medical leave
description: I've been a loyal customer for almost 2 years. I was on medical leave for 6 weeks and my credits expired while I was away. I had 1,400 credits unused. This feels really unfair given my history with your platform.
resolution: Escalated to Support Lead. Given 22-month tenure and documented medical leave circumstances, credits restored in full as loyalty exception. Noted in account: 'extenuating circumstances - medical leave, long-tenure customer'. Support Lead approved.

subject: API key returns 401 after rotation
description: We rotated our API key from the dashboard as recommended for security hygiene. The new key was generated successfully but all API calls return 401 Unauthorized. Our production pipeline is broken. This is urgent.
resolution: P1 incident declared. Bug identified: key rotation race condition causing up to 90s propagation delay. Workaround communicated (wait 2 mins) within 20 minutes. Hotfix deployed same day. Full service restored. SLA met: first response 8 minutes, resolution 2.5 hours.

subject: Request to cancel - 'we need to pause'
description: We'd like to cancel our subscription as soon as possible. Our team is going through a restructuring and we need to pause all non-essential SaaS spend temporarily.
resolution: Ticket immediately escalated to AE (per enterprise cancellation policy). AE reached out within 1 hour. After retention conversation, customer agreed to 60-day payment pause instead of cancellation. AE negotiated contract amendment. No cancellation processed.

subject: Video generation extremely slow - 45-60 seconds
description: Our video generation has been taking 45-60 seconds per generation for the past 2 hours. This is 3-4x slower than usual and is blocking our production content pipeline.
resolution: P1 declared (enterprise customer, significant latency degradation). Root cause: automated pipeline on customer end creating unusually high concurrent request volume, saturating their queue allocation. Queue allocation adjusted. Latency restored to 13s average. Resolution in 28 minutes from first report. No SLA breach.

subject: Refund request - platform missing 8K export feature
description: I signed up specifically because I read on your website that you support high-resolution exports. I need 8K output for a client project and the platform doesn't support it. I want a refund. I've only had the account for 3 days.
resolution: Customer is outside 48-hour standard refund window (day 3). However, investigation confirmed that the marketing page did reference 'high resolution exports' without explicitly specifying maximum resolution. Per policy exception for product misrepresentation, full refund approved. Customer notified. Marketing team flagged to update resolution specs page.

subject: Account suspended - I didn't violate anything
description: My account was suspended and I have no idea why. I was generating content for a client — news-style recap videos with public figures. All clearly marked as AI-generated. This is destroying my client relationship.
resolution: Content review completed. Videos contained realistic deepfake-style content of a politician with no watermark visible in exported files (watermark only shown during preview). This constitutes a Tier 2 violation (synthetic media intended to deceive). 7-day suspension maintained. Customer notified with specific policy section cited. Appeal option provided. Customer did not appeal within 72-hour window.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing - 3 days of missed events
description: We discovered today that our webhook endpoint has not been receiving delivery events for approximately 3 days. Our internal automation has been broken as a result. We need all missed events resent and an explanation of what happened.
resolution: P1 incident. Silent webhook delivery failure confirmed — 3-day gap. Root cause: misconfiguration in webhook retry logic after a deploy 3 days prior. Missed events partially resent (last 48 hours available in log, events before that not recoverable). SLA breach acknowledged — 3 days of P1 issue without detection. SLA credit of 30% off next invoice issued. Monitoring gap fixed. AE notified and managed customer relationship.

subject: Reactivation - want my old projects back
description: I cancelled my subscription about 2.5 months ago. I have a new client project that needs the platform. Is there any chance my old video projects and settings are still there?
resolution: Customer churned 76 days ago. Data retention policy: 90 days. All customer data confirmed still available. Full project history restored on reactivation. Offered 50% off first month back per win-back policy. Customer accepted. Account reactivated.

subject: Annual renewal failed - need credit extension
description: Our contract renewal was delayed due to procurement process. The contract lapsed for 8 days before our finance team processed the new PO. We now have an active contract but our credits appear to have expired during the gap.
resolution: Contract gap confirmed by AE. This is classified as a procurement delay, not a credit expiry scenario. Full credit restoration approved per enterprise contract gap policy. Credits restored retroactively. AE confirmed new contract active in Salesforce before restoration.

subject: Churn concern - multiple issues this month
description: We've had 3 issues this month: slow generation (resolved), a billing discrepancy (resolved), and now our main use case (batch exports) is erroring intermittently. We're reconsidering the subscription.
resolution: Account flagged as at-risk: 3 issues in 30 days + explicit churn signal. Annual Pro = CSM touch required within 48 hours. CSM contacted customer next day. Batch export bug identified and fixed within 24 hours of ticket. CSM offered 1 free month extension as goodwill for the difficult month. Customer confirmed they are staying.

subject: Refund request - lifetime deal customer
description: I purchased a lifetime deal 18 months ago. I feel the product has significantly changed since then and no longer serves my needs. I would like a refund of my original purchase price.
resolution: Lifetime deal refund policy is clear: no refunds under any circumstances per LTD terms agreed at purchase. Customer was shown the LTD terms they accepted at purchase. No refund issued. Customer offered 1:1 product consultation session to explore if their use case could be served. Customer declined further assistance.
